correctness.rationale: Cayley transform of rational positive-atomic Herglotz F_a is a degree-three finite Blaschke product; proper restriction and simply connected components imply N(c)=3−Σ mult(F′ critical points with Re F>c), with strict > accounting for boundary levels. Derivative F′(z)=2/(1−z)^2[a−1+9z²/(1+z+z²)^2] locates two interior critical points. The discriminant of F_a(z)=w yields quartic 9w^4+6(a²−20a−8)w²+a(a+8)^3; solving gives exact squared critical values and real/conjugate regimes. Difference of squared heights is 16/3(1−a)^(3/2), total heights→6, so 8/9 coefficient. Independent Sympy derivative/discriminant and sign-regime check corroborates algebra, not topology by sampling.
